supersedes: target-extension-freeze-08 after its smoke-04 was stopped at five API attempts when preregistration audit found shared target-extension repair accounting and incomplete mechanical gate bindings
extension_output_repair_contract: First-layer structural repair, semantic extension repair that returns to first-layer decomposition, and same-contract probe-output replacement each have an independent counter and cap. An accepted immutable claim contract with an extra, missing or misbound probe reruns only the extension stage once; it cannot revise the claim contract. Relation probes are legal only when target logic has that exact relation kind.

preserved_runs.reports/target-extension-v2-smoke-01: Execution environment lacked the optional model client; zero API attempts.
preserved_runs.reports/target-extension-v2-smoke-02: p02 completed, while p08 returned one illegal comparison_relation probe under global and logic after two successful API calls; the strict validator stopped the run.
preserved_runs.reports/target-extension-v2-smoke-03: The prior two-case smoke completed p02 and p08 with all frozen gates passing; retained as the pre-designation-relation checkpoint.
preserved_runs.reports/target-extension-v2-dev-01: Preserved failed full attempt: seven cases stopped on HTTP 429 transport errors; p07 alone stopped on the now-fixed designation morphology validator. It is not scored as semantic accuracy zero.
preserved_runs.reports/target-extension-v2-smoke-04: Stopped by the operator after five p02 API attempts when independent preregistration audit found shared repair accounting. It contains no completed prediction and is excluded from scoring.

logic_contract: single retains one claim; and/or contain only flat standalone branches; attribution contains one reporting parent plus flat conjunctive attributed-content children; conditional/comparison/causal retain one complete relation and require a relation-specific all-dimension probe; mixed fails closed without an expression tree.
identity_contract: entity_identity is same-referent matching and accepts exact mention, alias, unambiguous description or anaphora. exact_designation is permitted only for an explicit naming predicate. Overlapping nested identity spans are rejected.
designation_relation_contract: Every claim containing exact_designation has exactly one designation_relation probe bound to all claim dimensions, routed to atoms, evidence and world, gated always, with semantic_constraint matching. A conclusive designation_relation result must ground, in one sentence or line, an explicit naming predicate cue and every exact target designation after case-folding and whitespace normalization with lexical boundaries. This lexical structural gate does not independently prove actor, direction or date semantics.
result_contract: Evidence and world return exactly one grounded result per projected probe. Python validates plan checksum, projections, bindings, result relations and basis, then deterministically aggregates; the model cannot choose or override the overall verdict.
loop_contract: Every returned snapshot is decomposed again. Probe-owned gaps are linked to one unresolved probe. Each round recomputes whether prior active gaps still block; nondecisive unresolved branches become nonblocking without being falsely marked resolved, and conclusive probe results close their prior tasks with current basis.
transport_contract: Run one case at a time with workers=1 and SDK automatic retries disabled. Any HTTP 429 or other call error fails the frozen smoke; preserve the run without selective reruns or cherry-picking. A retry-policy change requires a new freeze and a fresh all-arm run.

gate.execution: p02, p07 and p08 must all complete two rounds with no call error, model mismatch or budget overrun; returned responses must equal attempts and checkpoints must be rounds 1 and 2. Config and captured model_io must show zero automatic transport retries, and every repair counter must equal its frozen independent cap.
gate.labels: p02 and p07 round1 and final must be false; p08 round1 and final must be true. Smoke accuracy must be 3/3 with zero fixes and zero breaks against both completed baselines.
gate.probe_audit: All three plans must pass independent v2 SHA, target-anchor, binding, stable-ID, projection, Boolean-role, bound-count and program-policy validation. Six accepted verification cycles must have exactly-one result-slot coverage 1.0 and grounded-conclusive rate 1.0.
gate.p02: Exactly one attribution parent and at least one linked attributed-content child; no parent dimension may extend past 'reported that'. Final-total, Bennu, OSIRIS-REx and 70.3 grams belong to content. Every round must ground the contradicted final-total obligation in m03.
gate.p07: Exactly one claim, with GOES-U as entity_identity and GOES-19 as exact_designation, no duplicate or overlapping IDs, and exactly one all-dimension designation_relation probe with the frozen routing, gate and match policy. In both rounds, time_boundary and designation_relation must be contradicted in evidence and world and grounded by an m13 sentence containing July 7, 2024, a naming cue and exact GOES-19; identity and designation results require their corresponding exact name in m13, and no time, designation or identity gap may remain.
gate.p08: No overlapping entity/designation spans and no exact_designation probe. The map-product entity probe must use same_referent and be supported in both evidence rounds from m15 by exact/alias/description/anaphora, with no identity gap. No fetch may repeat an already-visible m14/m15 URL. The graph must retain m14 to m15 direct citation and m15 as origin.
gate.failure_policy: Any failed conjunct preserves smoke-05 and stops the full run. A code or prompt change requires a new freeze and a fresh smoke directory. No failed run is overwritten.

proof_limit: The three-case gate detects the known attribution, designation and same-referent regressions. The eight previously seen purposive development cases can show recovery or non-regression only. Neither proves an accuracy increase; that requires event-disjoint, independently adjudicated held-out cases.
